hero.lead: Rooftop solar designed, installed and serviced from Los Angeles — every PG&E, SCE, SDG&E, SMUD and LADWP zip code. Federal tax credit handled, paperwork done, panels on in 21 days.

costShrink.title: Watch your bill shrink.
costShrink.lead: On day 1, your bill drops to almost nothing. The few dollars you still pay covers the connection fee and any night-time grid usage. The savings start immediately.

quickCheck.title: Is solar right for your roof?
quickCheck.lead: Three honest yes-or-no questions. We'll tell you the truth — even if the answer is "wait a year".

howItWorks.title:
From bill shock to power-on
in twenty-one days.
howItWorks.lead: One team. Six steps. Every permit, every conduit, every inspection — handled. No subcontractors disappearing after the deposit. No utility runaround.
howItWorks.promise: If we miss the 21-day mark, we pay your next month's bill. In writing, on every contract.

timeline.title:
From "yes" to power-on,
tracked day by day.
timeline.lead: Other installers say "21 days" and ghost. We send you a text update at every milestone — and a guarantee in writing if we slip.

liveGen.title:
Three thousand roofs.
One sun. Working for them all.
liveGen.lead: Every panel we've installed is online and reporting back. Watch the meters tick — these are the real kilowatt-hours our customers are generating right now.

packages.title:
Or skip the math —
pick a package.
packages.lead: Three sizes that fit 90% of California homes. Tier-1 components only. Federal tax credit applied to the price you see.

partners.title:
Tier-1 only.
No grey-market panels.
partners.lead: We only install what we'd put on our own roof. These are the brands that survive 25 California summers — others fail in 5.

story.title:
The Morales family's bill went from
$380 to $14.
story.lead: 7 kW system, single-floor bungalow in LA's Highland Park. Installed February 2026. Federal tax credit of $5,880 dropped straight into their 2026 return.

trust.title:
California's roofs deserve
a California installer.
trust.lead: We've been wiring panels onto roofs from San Diego to Sacramento since 2019. Here's what we do differently.

gallery.title: Across the whole state.
gallery.lead: A few of the rooftops we've recently powered. Real systems, real owners — we'll connect you to any of them.

subsidy.title:
30% off your install,
direct from the IRS.
subsidy.lead: The Residential Clean Energy Credit (IRC §25D) pays 30% of your installed cost back as a dollar-for-dollar federal tax credit. We hand you the IRS Form 5695 worksheet at commissioning.

pulse.title: We service every IOU territory in California.

faq.title:
Things people
actually ask.

finalCta.title:
The next bill could be
your last.
finalCta.lead: Free site survey. Tax credit modeled in writing. Power-on in 21 days.
